sql: WITH productos_mas_vendidos AS (SELECT p.producto_id, p.nombre, SUM(dv.cantidad) AS unidades_vendidas FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.productos AS p ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id WHERE v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND v.estado = 'completada' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY p.producto_id, p.nombre ORDER BY unidades_vendidas DESC LIMIT 5), sucursales_con_ingresos AS (SELECT s.sucursal_id, s.nombre AS nombre_sucursal, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON v.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id WHERE v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND v.estado = 'completada' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY s.sucursal_id, s.nombre ORDER BY ingresos DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT * FROM productos_mas_vendidos, sucursales_con_ingresos LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Cuál fue el crecimiento porcentual de los ingresos de cada región entre enero-octubre de 2025 y enero-octubre de 2026?
sql: WITH ingresos_regionales AS (SELECT r.nombre AS region, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON v.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id JOIN retail.regiones AS r ON s.region_id = r.region_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2025-11-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY r.nombre), ingresos_regionales_2026 AS (SELECT r.nombre AS region, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON v.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id JOIN retail.regiones AS r ON s.region_id = r.region_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY r.nombre) SELECT r.nombre AS region, COALESCE(ir.ingresos, 0) AS ingresos_2025, COALESCE(ir2.ingresos, 0) AS ingresos_2026 FROM retail.regiones AS r LEFT JOIN ingresos_regionales AS ir ON r.nombre = ir.region LEFT JOIN ingresos_regionales_2026 AS ir2 ON r.nombre = ir2.region LIMIT 1000

WITH ingresos_regionales AS (SELECT r.nombre AS region, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON v.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id JOIN retail.regiones AS r ON s.region_id = r.region_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY r.nombre) SELECT region, ingresos FROM ingresos_regionales LIMIT 1000

WITH ingresos_regionales AS (SELECT r.nombre AS region, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON v.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id JOIN retail.regiones AS r ON s.region_id = r.region_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2025-11-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY r.nombre UNION ALL SELECT r.nombre AS region, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON v.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id JOIN retail.regiones AS r ON s.region_id = r.region_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY r.nombre), ingresos_2025 AS (SELECT region, ingresos AS ingresos_2025 FROM ingresos_regionales WHERE region IN (SELECT nombre FROM retail.regiones) AND ingresos IS NOT NULL), ingresos_2026 AS (SELECT region, ingresos AS ingresos_2026 FROM ingresos_regionales WHERE region IN (SELECT nombre FROM retail.regiones) AND ingresos IS NOT NULL), crecimiento AS (SELECT i2025.region, ROUND((i2026.ingresos_2026 - i2025.ingresos_2025) * 100.0 / i2025.ingresos_2025, 2) AS crecimiento_porcentual FROM ingresos_2025 AS i2025 JOIN ingresos_2026 AS i2026 ON i2025.region = i2026.region) SELECT region, crecimiento_porcentual FROM crecimiento ORDER BY region LIMIT 1000

sql: WITH ingresos_categoria AS (SELECT c.nombre AS categoria, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.productos AS p ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id JOIN retail.categorias AS c ON p.categoria_id = c.categoria_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY c.nombre), total_ingresos AS (SELECT SUM(ingresos) AS total FROM ingresos_categoria) SELECT categoria, ROUND(ingresos * 100.0 / total, 2) AS porcentaje FROM ingresos_categoria, total_ingresos LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Cuál fue el margen bruto como porcentaje de los ingresos en cada categoría en 2025?
sql: WITH ingresos_categoria AS (SELECT c.nombre AS categoria, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos_total FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.productos AS p ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id JOIN retail.categorias AS c ON p.categoria_id = c.categoria_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY c.nombre), margen_categoria AS (SELECT c.nombre AS categoria, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos_total, SUM(dv.cantidad * p.costo_unitario) AS costo_total FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.productos AS p ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id JOIN retail.categorias AS c ON p.categoria_id = c.categoria_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY c.nombre) SELECT i.categoria, ROUND((i.ingresos_total - m.costo_total) / i.ingresos_total * 100, 2) AS margen_bruto_porcentaje FROM ingresos_categoria AS i JOIN margen_categoria AS m ON i.categoria = m.categoria LIMIT 1000

WITH ingresos_categoria AS (SELECT c.categoria_id, c.nombre AS categoria, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.productos AS p ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id JOIN retail.categorias AS c ON p.categoria_id = c.categoria_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY c.categoria_id, c.nombre), costos_categoria AS (SELECT p.categoria_id, c.nombre AS categoria, SUM(p.costo_unitario * dv.cantidad) AS costo_total FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.productos AS p ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id JOIN retail.categorias AS c ON p.categoria_id = c.categoria_id WHERE dv.venta_id IN (SELECT venta_id FROM retail.ventas WHERE estado = 'completada' AND fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY p.categoria_id, c.nombre) SELECT i.categoria, (i.ingresos - COALESCE(c.costo_total, 0)) / i.ingresos * 100 AS margen_bruto_porcentaje FROM ingresos_categoria AS i JOIN costos_categoria AS c ON i.categoria_id = c.categoria_id ORDER BY margen_bruto_porcentaje DESC LIMIT 1

WITH ingresos_categoria AS (SELECT c.categoria_id, c.nombre AS categoria, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.productos AS p ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id JOIN retail.categorias AS c ON p.categoria_id = c.categoria_id WHERE v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.estado = 'completada' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY c.categoria_id, c.nombre), margen_categoria AS (SELECT c.categoria_id, c.nombre AS categoria, SUM(dv.cantidad * p.costo_unitario) AS costo_total FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.productos AS p ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id JOIN retail.categorias AS c ON p.categoria_id = c.categoria_id WHERE v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.estado = 'completada' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY c.categoria_id, c.nombre) SELECT mc.categoria, (mc.costo_total / ic.ingresos) * 100 AS margen_bruto_porcentaje FROM margen_categoria AS mc JOIN ingresos_categoria AS ic ON mc.categoria_id = ic.categoria_id ORDER BY margen_bruto_porcentaje DESC LIMIT 1

outcomes.question: ¿Cuántas unidades de Útiles Escolares vendió la Costa en abril y mayo de 2026, y cuántas la Sierra en agosto y septiembre de 2026?

outcomes.question: ¿Qué sucursal tuvo el mayor crecimiento porcentual de ingresos del primer semestre de 2025 al primer semestre de 2026, considerando solo sucursales con ventas en ambos semestres?
sql: WITH sucursal_ingresos AS (SELECT s.sucursal_id, s.nombre, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.sucursales AS s JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON s.sucursal_id = v.sucursal_id JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) AND (v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2025-07-01' AS DATE) OR v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)) GROUP BY s.sucursal_id, s.nombre), sucursal_ingresos_detalle AS (SELECT s.sucursal_id, s.nombre, SUM(CASE WHEN v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2025-07-01' AS DATE) THEN dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento ELSE 0 END) AS ingresos_2025, SUM(CASE WHEN v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) THEN dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento ELSE 0 END) AS ingresos_2026 FROM retail.sucursales AS s JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON s.sucursal_id = v.sucursal_id JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) AND (v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2025-07-01' AS DATE) OR v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)) GROUP BY s.sucursal_id, s.nombre) SELECT sucursal_id, nombre, ingresos_2025, ingresos_2026 FROM sucursal_ingresos_detalle LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Cuáles fueron los 3 productos con más ingresos en cada región durante el último trimestre?
sql: WITH ingresos_por_producto AS (SELECT p.sku, p.nombre, r.nombre AS region, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.productos AS p ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON v.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id JOIN retail.regiones AS r ON s.region_id = r.region_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY p.sku, p.nombre, r.nombre), top_3_regiones AS (SELECT region, sku, nombre AS producto, ingresos, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY ingresos DESC) AS rn FROM ingresos_por_producto) SELECT region, producto, ingresos FROM top_3_regiones WHERE rn <= 3 LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Qué producto tuvo la mayor tasa de devolución (unidades devueltas sobre unidades vendidas) en las ventas completadas del tercer trimestre de 2025, entre los productos con al menos 50 unidades vendidas?
sql: WITH ventas_completadas AS (SELECT dv.producto_id, SUM(dv.cantidad) AS unidades_vendidas FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-07-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY dv.producto_id), devoluciones_producto AS (SELECT d.detalle_id, d.cantidad AS unidades_devueltas FROM retail.devoluciones AS d JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-07-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE)), unidades_devueltas_producto AS (SELECT dv.producto_id, SUM(d.unidades_devueltas) AS unidades_devueltas FROM devoluciones_producto AS d JOIN detalle_ventas AS dv ON d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id GROUP BY dv.producto_id), tasa_devolucion AS (SELECT v.producto_id, COALESCE(v.unidades_vendidas, 0) AS unidades_vendidas, COALESCE(d.unidades_devueltas, 0) AS unidades_devueltas FROM ventas_completadas AS v LEFT JOIN unidades_devueltas_producto AS d ON v.producto_id = d.producto_id WHERE v.unidades_vendidas >= 50) SELECT p.nombre AS producto, (unidades_devueltas * 100.0 / unidades_vendidas) AS tasa_devolucion FROM tasa_devolucion AS td JOIN retail.productos AS p ON td.producto_id = p.producto_id ORDER BY tasa_devolucion DESC LIMIT 1

outcomes.question: ¿Qué porcentaje de las ventas completadas de cada año fueron online?

outcomes.question: ¿Cuál fue el ticket promedio por segmento de cliente registrado en 2025?
sql: WITH ingresos_segmento AS (SELECT c.segmento, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos_total, COUNT(DISTINCT dv.venta_id) AS ventas_total FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.clientes AS c ON v.cliente_id = c.cliente_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.cliente_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY c.segmento), ventas_segmento AS (SELECT c.segmento, COUNT(DISTINCT dv.venta_id) AS ventas_total FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.clientes AS c ON v.cliente_id = c.cliente_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.cliente_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY c.segmento) SELECT i.segmento, ROUND(CAST((i.ingresos_total / v.ventas_total) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS ticket_promedio FROM ingresos_segmento AS i JOIN ventas_segmento AS v ON i.segmento = v.segmento LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Qué categoría tuvo el mayor crecimiento porcentual de unidades vendidas del segundo trimestre de 2026 al tercer trimestre de 2026?
sql: WITH ventas_completadas AS (SELECT d.detalle_id, d.venta_id, d.producto_id, d.cantidad, d.precio_unitario, d.descuento FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS d JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON d.venta_id = v.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)), devoluciones_excluidas AS (SELECT detalle_id FROM retail.devoluciones WHERE fecha_devolucion >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND fecha_devolucion < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE)) SELECT c.nombre AS categoria, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.detalle_id IN (SELECT detalle_id FROM devoluciones_excluidas) THEN d.cantidad ELSE 0 END) AS unidades_vendidas FROM ventas_completadas AS d JOIN retail.productos AS p ON d.producto_id = p.producto_id JOIN retail.categorias AS c ON p.categoria_id = c.categoria_id GROUP BY c.nombre, c.categoria_id LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Cuál fue el crecimiento porcentual de los ingresos de diciembre de 2025 frente a diciembre de 2024 en cada región?
sql: WITH ingresos_regionales AS (SELECT r.nombre AS region, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON v.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id JOIN retail.regiones AS r ON s.region_id = r.region_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2024-12-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY r.nombre) SELECT region, ingresos AS ingresos_diciembre_2024 FROM ingresos_regionales LIMIT 1000

WITH ingresos_por_region AS (SELECT r.nombre AS region, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON v.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id JOIN retail.regiones AS r ON s.region_id = r.region_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-12-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY r.nombre) SELECT r.nombre AS region, COALESCE(ipr.ingresos, 0) AS ingresos_2025 FROM retail.regiones AS r LEFT JOIN ingresos_por_region AS ipr ON r.nombre = ipr.region LIMIT 1000

WITH ingresos_regionales AS (SELECT r.nombre AS region, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON v.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id JOIN retail.regiones AS r ON s.region_id = r.region_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-12-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY r.nombre), ingresos_regionales_2024 AS (SELECT r.nombre AS region, SUM(dv.cantidad * dv.precio_unitario - dv.descuento) AS ingresos_2024 FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.sucursales AS s ON v.sucursal_id = s.sucursal_id JOIN retail.regiones AS r ON s.region_id = r.region_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2024-12-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY r.nombre) SELECT ir.region, ROUND((ir.ingresos - ir_2024.ingresos_2024) * 100.0 / ir_2024.ingresos_2024, 2) AS crecimiento_porcentual FROM ingresos_regionales AS ir JOIN ingresos_regionales_2024 AS ir_2024 ON ir.region = ir_2024.region LIMIT 1000

outcomes.question: ¿Cuál es la tasa de devolución en porcentaje de cada categoría para las ventas completadas de 2025?
sql: WITH ventas_por_categoria AS (SELECT c.categoria_id, c.nombre AS categoria_nombre, COUNT(DISTINCT dv.venta_id) AS total_ventas_completadas FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.productos AS p ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id JOIN retail.categorias AS c ON p.categoria_id = c.categoria_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.categoria_id, c.nombre), devoluciones_por_categoria AS (SELECT c.categoria_id, c.nombre AS categoria_nombre, COUNT(DISTINCT d.detalle_id) AS total_devoluciones FROM retail.devoluciones AS d JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id JOIN retail.productos AS p ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id JOIN retail.categorias AS c ON p.categoria_id = c.categoria_id JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.categoria_id, c.nombre) SELECT vc.categoria_nombre, ROUND((CAST(d.total_devoluciones AS DECIMAL) / CAST(vc.total_ventas_completadas AS DECIMAL)) * 100, 2) AS tasa_devolucion FROM ventas_por_categoria AS vc JOIN devoluciones_por_categoria AS d ON vc.categoria_id = d.categoria_id ORDER BY tasa_devolucion DESC LIMIT 1

WITH devoluciones_categoria AS (SELECT p.categoria_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.detalle_id) AS devoluciones_por_categoria FROM retail.devoluciones AS d JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id JOIN retail.productos AS p ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id WHERE d.fecha_devolucion >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND d.fecha_devolucion < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.categoria_id), ventas_categoria AS (SELECT p.categoria_id, COUNT(DISTINCT dv.detalle_id) AS ventas_por_categoria FROM retail.ventas AS v JOIN retail.detalle_ventas AS dv ON v.venta_id = dv.venta_id JOIN retail.productos AS p ON dv.producto_id = p.producto_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.categoria_id) SELECT c.nombre AS categoria, dc.devoluciones_por_categoria AS numero_devoluciones FROM retail.categorias AS c JOIN devoluciones_categoria AS dc ON c.categoria_id = dc.categoria_id ORDER BY dc.devoluciones_por_categoria DESC LIMIT 1

WITH ventas_completadas AS (SELECT dv.detalle_id, dv.venta_id, dv.cantidad, dv.precio_unitario, dv.descuento, dv.producto_id FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)), devoluciones_categoria AS (SELECT d.detalle_id, d.cantidad AS cantidad_devuelta, d.venta_id, dv.producto_id FROM retail.devoluciones AS d JOIN ventas_completadas AS dv ON d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id), unidades_vendidas_categoria AS (SELECT producto_id, SUM(cantidad) AS unidades_vendidas FROM ventas_completadas GROUP BY producto_id), unidades_devueltas_categoria AS (SELECT producto_id, SUM(cantidad_devuelta) AS unidades_devueltas FROM devoluciones_categoria GROUP BY producto_id), tasa_devolucion_categoria AS (SELECT u.producto_id, u.unidades_vendidas, d.unidades_devueltas, (d.unidades_devueltas * 100.0 / u.unidades_vendidas) AS tasa_devolucion FROM unidades_vendidas_categoria AS u JOIN unidades_devueltas_categoria AS d ON u.producto_id = d.producto_id WHERE u.unidades_vendidas > 0), categoria_producto AS (SELECT p.producto_id, c.nombre AS categoria FROM retail.productos AS p JOIN retail.categorias AS c ON p.categoria_id = c.categoria_id) SELECT c.categoria, ROUND(t.tasa_devolucion, 2) AS tasa_devolucion FROM tasa_devolucion_categoria AS t JOIN categoria_producto AS c ON t.producto_id = c.producto_id GROUP BY c.categoria, t.tasa_devolucion ORDER BY t.tasa_devolucion DESC LIMIT 1000

sql: WITH ventas_completas AS (SELECT dv.producto_id, SUM(dv.cantidad) AS unidades_vendidas FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM retail.devoluciones AS d WHERE d.detalle_id = dv.detalle_id) GROUP BY dv.producto_id), productos AS (SELECT p.producto_id, p.nombre FROM retail.productos AS p JOIN ventas_completas AS vc ON p.producto_id = vc.producto_id) SELECT p.producto_id, p.nombre AS producto, vc.unidades_vendidas AS unidades_vendidas FROM productos AS p JOIN ventas_completas AS vc ON p.producto_id = vc.producto_id ORDER BY vc.unidades_vendidas DESC LIMIT 5

sql: WITH ventas_completas AS (SELECT dv.producto_id, SUM(dv.cantidad) AS unidades_vendidas FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY dv.producto_id), devoluciones AS (SELECT dv.producto_id, SUM(dv.cantidad) AS unidades_devueltas FROM retail.detalle_ventas AS dv JOIN retail.ventas AS v ON dv.venta_id = v.venta_id JOIN retail.devoluciones AS d ON dv.detalle_id = d.detalle_id WHERE v.estado = 'completada' AND v.fecha_venta >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND v.fecha_venta < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY dv.producto_id), unidades_netas AS (SELECT v.producto_id, COALESCE(v.unidades_vendidas, 0) - COALESCE(d.unidades_devueltas, 0) AS unidades_netas FROM ventas_completas AS v LEFT JOIN devoluciones AS d ON v.producto_id = d.producto_id) SELECT p.nombre AS producto, un.unidades_netas FROM retail.productos AS p JOIN unidades_netas AS un ON p.producto_id = un.producto_id ORDER BY un.unidades_netas DESC LIMIT 5

outcomes.question: ¿Cuál es el ticket promedio por método de pago este año?
